referenceFunction.generalComment: Disposal of various components for a ventilation system for a residential care home with apartments, kitchen, cafe/restaurant, multi-purpose hall, wellness area and laundry. The inventory is based on a building with a total heated gross floor area of 34460 m2 and a total nominal air flow of m3/h, total weight of the components: 10195 kg/Unit m3/h per m2 heated gross floor area. Data from call of bid including components for air valves, air intake, roof-hoods, dampers, fire dampers, silencers and sensors.; UUID: 5bb336e1-f4a3-4371-8b86-07877070c7d6
